# Israel Ojiefoh

> Public professional portfolio for Israel Ojiefoh, a backend Python, full-stack, and mobile engineer focused on high-concurrency fintech APIs, production-ready mobile apps, backend microservices, and SaaS platforms.

## Summary

Israel Ojiefoh is a Backend Python, Full-Stack, and Mobile Engineer. His work covers high-concurrency Python APIs (FastAPI, Asyncio, Celery), fintech transaction engines, double-entry financial ledgers, idempotent payment/escrow integrations, React Native iOS and Android apps, NestJS and Express APIs, PostgreSQL optimization, Redis caching, Docker/Kubernetes deployment, SaaS integrations, data pipelines, and machine learning workflow education.

## Services

- Python & Fintech Engineering: High-concurrency Python APIs (FastAPI, Asyncio, Celery), double-entry ledgers, race-condition safety, and idempotent payment processing.
- Mobile Engineering: React Native, iOS, Android, EAS deployment, offline state sync, and native app experiences.
- Backend Microservices & Architecture: Secure REST APIs, NestJS, Express, WebSockets, and performance-tuned PostgreSQL databases.
- Payment & Escrow Integrations: Payment gateways (Stripe, Paystack), milestone-based escrow release logic, merchant dashboards, and Shopify Apps.
- Cloud and DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, Redis caching, and deployment automation.
- Data Pipelines & Full-Stack Prototyping: Feature extraction, data engineering, product architecture, API design, and deployed MVPs.

## Selected Projects

- [RendezvousCare](https://www.rendezvouscare.com/): Comprehensive wellness platform with high-volume checkout infrastructure, appointment scheduling, licensed therapy access, commerce, gift cards, and affiliate rewards.
- [Entrant](https://www.myentrant.com/): Country-arrival guidance platform for newcomers, combining visa rules, scam warnings, local systems, navigation, care passage, benefits, community, mentor matching, compliance reminders, and arrival glossaries into one trusted path.
- [ElAura](https://elaura.pxxl.click/): African creator-brand partnership platform featuring Python backend escrow payment infrastructure, idempotent payout triggers, milestone tracking, influencer discovery, and creator payout operations.
